newsitem.title: USA: All-Comm Media Corp in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: All-Comm Media Corp in acquisition talks.

text.p: All-Comm Media Corp said on Tuesday that it was in discussions with several acquisition candidates and that it had retained William Blair & Co to raise additional funds for expansion.
"We are presently in discussions with several acquisition candidates," said chief executive Jeremy Barbera.
He added that William Blair & Co's intent was "to close a $15-20 million private financing with a strategic partner.
"This will help fund our acquisitions and expand the size and scope of the database and marketing services we currently provide," Barbera said.
All-Comm Media Corp provides database marketing services, custom telemarketing and telefundraising services.
